situation.zh: 手上的活已经排满到周末,同事又来请你接一件新的。你要说清接不了、为什么接不了,并给出一个你确实做得到的替代安排。
situation.en: Your week is already full and a colleague asks you to take on one more job. You need to say you cannot, why not, and offer something you can actually do instead.

npc.persona: A colleague under pressure who will take a clear no over a vague yes. Reasonable once the reason is on the table.
npc.greeting: Could you take one more this week?

hit: Your week is full already — I did not know that. Next Monday works for me, so let us say Monday and I will tell them.
Fair enough. You cannot this week, and you can start Monday. I would rather have that than a yes that slips.
partial: So is that a no for now, or a no for the whole week?
I hear you are busy. When could you take it?
miss: Hmm? I did not catch that. One more time?

slots.zh_hint: 为什么接不了:手上已经排满
给出你做得到的替代安排
把替代安排说具体(专业度标记)

reference_answer: I cannot take it this week, my week is already full. I could start on Monday if that still helps.

provenance.rationale: 拒绝一件多出来的活,是职场里最频繁又最难开口的一次表达。非母语者常因为词不够用而含糊答应,结果延期时失去的信誉比当初拒绝更多 —— 这一条的教学意义正在于「说不」是一项可练的表达,不是态度问题。归到第 4 层(尊重)而不是第 3 层(归属):它要维护的是自己的时间与信誉边界,不是求接纳。
provenance.frequency_basis: 需求金字塔第 4 层(尊重与自我边界)。用词全部落在 NGSL 首千内:cannot#38 / work#67 / next#151 / week#157 / already#302 / full#410 / start#136 / able#271 / jobs#231,busy#1233 略出首千但在第二千段内且是本场景最差的一个;weekday 名(monday 等)按 NGSL 结构性盲区处理,须由 CEFR-J 等级侧定级。难度不在词汇而在把「拒绝 + 原因 + 替代」三件事在一次回答里讲完 —— 只说 no 会命中 decline 而漏掉后两个必需槽位,这正是本场景想练的东西。
